title: Nightly 2026-10-22 UI overlaps
description: Overlaps from the 2026-10-22 sweep. (1) Diplomacy: 'Choose myself' on the prepared secondary now holds for the whole secondary window, so the follow-up ready-planets question no longer brings the 'Prepared / Confirm' bar back over its Confirm; a bar that is up anyway docks above the ready-planets bar. (2) Phone: the system inspector starts below the header chips (the paused-prompts chip covered its close button), and Warfare's free tactical action closes an open inspector like the normal activation does. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server. The before shots are taken with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before on the commit without the change.

shots.heading: Before: after Choose myself, desktop
shots.caption: The follow-up ready question brought the Prepared bar back over the ready-planets bar.

shots.heading: After: after Choose myself, desktop
shots.caption: Only the ready-planets bar; its Confirm is the topmost element.

shots.caption: The Prepared bar sits on top of the ready-planets Confirm.

shots.heading: After: bar not dismissed, desktop
shots.caption: The Prepared bar docks above the ready-planets bar; both Confirm buttons are reachable.

shots.heading: After: inspector close button, phone
shots.caption: The inspector starts below the header chips; the close button is the topmost element.
